exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

Internet, shubhasiz, tarixdagi eng
muhim ixtirolardan biri. U 1968
yilda AQSh hukumati tomonidan
boshlangan, lekin dastlab asosan
olimlar tomonidan ishlatilgan. 1990
yildan, Butunjahon o'rgimchak to'ri
yaratilganidan beri, u dunyoni
o'zgartirdi va uning qo'llanilishi
har kuni o'sib bormoqda.

1) Internet aslida nima?
Internet - telefon liniyalari,
sun'iy yo'ldosh yoki kabel orqali
ulangan, dunyo bo'ylab millionlab
kompyuterlar tarmog'i (aslida bir
necha tarmoq), shunda tarmoqdagi
barcha kompyuterlar bir-biri bilan
ma'lumot almasha oladi.

2) Bu Veb bilan bir xil narsami?
Unchalik emas. Internet
KOMPYUTERLARNI bog'laydi, Butunjahon
o'rgimchak to'ri esa bu
kompyuterlarda saqlanadigan
MA'LUMOTNI bog'lovchi tizim.

3) Veb-sayt nima va unga qanday
kiraman?
Kompaniya yoki tashkilot
ma'lumotini dunyoning biror yeridagi
Internet kompyuterlaridan birida
elektron hujjatlarda saqlaydi. Bu
kompyuter maydoni - kompaniyaning
veb-sayti - har telefonda raqam
bo'lgani kabi manzilga ega. Saytga
kirish uchun shunchaki manzilni
kiritasiz. Kompyuteringiz saytga
ulanadi, hujjat yuklab olinadi va
ekraningizda sahifa paydo bo'ladi.

4) Internetda qanday 'kezaman'?
Ma'lumot izlab saytga kirganingizda,
sahifadagi ba'zi so'zlar tagiga
chizilgan bo'lishi mumkin - bu mavzu
haqida boshqa hujjatda ko'proq
ma'lumot borligini ko'rsatadi. Agar
shu so'zlardan biriga bossangiz, Veb
avtomatik ravishda kompyuteringizni
yangi hujjat yoki saytga ulaydi -
hatto u minglab kilometr uzoqda
saqlansa ham. Siz Internetda
kezyapsiz!

5) Internetdan nima uchun
foydalanishim mumkin?
Internetning asosiy vazifasi -
ma'lumot topish: maktab ishi yoki
ish uchun, yoki shunchaki sevimli
mashg'ulot, sport yoki joriy voqealar
haqida ko'proq bilish uchun.
Internetdan gazeta va jurnal o'qish,
o'yin o'ynash, ta'til rejalashtirish
yoki sevimli do'koningizdan narsa
sotib olish uchun ham foydalanishingiz
mumkin. E-mail dunyoning istalgan
yeriga soniyalarda elektron xabar
yuborishga imkon beradi, va
Internetdan odamlar bilan 'suhbat'
qurish va yangi do'stlar orttirish
uchun foydalanishingiz mumkin.

6) Internetdan foydalanish uchun nima
kerak?
Agar hali Internetdan
foydalanmasangiz, boshlash uchun
kerak bo'lgan narsa - kompyuter,
modem va telefon liniyasi.
Internetdan foydalanish tobora
arzonlashib va osonlashib bormoqda.
Internetda kezishga tayyormisiz? U
yerda sizni butun hayajonli Internet
dunyosi kutmoqda!


QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  without doubt = shubhasiz
  inventions = ixtirolar
  mainly = asosan
  created = yaratilgan
  are growing = o'sib bormoqda
  connected = ulangan
  exchange = almashmoq
  space = maydon, joy
  enter the address = manzilni
    kiritmoq
  underlined = tagiga chizilgan
  subject = mavzu
  click = bosmoq
  automatically = avtomatik
  surfing the net = Internetda
    kezish
  current events = joriy voqealar
  chat = suhbatlashmoq


⚠ 'FAQ':

  = Frequently Asked Questions -
  tez-tez so'raladigan savollar.


⚠ 'THE GOVERNMENT':

  = hukumat.


⚠ 'A SCIENTIST':

  = unchalik emas.

tasks.en: The Internet is without doubt one of the most important inventions in history. It was started in 1968 by the US government, but at first it was used mainly by scientists. Since 1990, when the World Wide Web was created, it has changed the world, and its uses are growing every day.
tasks.uz: Internet, shubhasiz, tarixdagi eng muhim ixtirolardan biri. U 1968 yilda AQSh hukumati tomonidan boshlangan, lekin dastlab asosan olimlar tomonidan ishlatilgan. 1990 yildan, Butunjahon o'rgimchak to'ri yaratilganidan beri, u dunyoni o'zgartirdi va uning qo'llanilishi har kuni o'sib bormoqda.

tasks.en: 1 (a) What exactly is the Internet? The Internet is a network (several networks, in fact) of millions of computers around the world, connected by phone lines, satellite or cable, so that all the computers on the net can exchange information with each other.
tasks.uz: 1 (a) Internet aslida nima? Internet - telefon liniyalari, sun'iy yo'ldosh yoki kabel orqali ulangan, dunyo bo'ylab millionlab kompyuterlar tarmog'i, shunda tarmoqdagi barcha kompyuterlar bir-biri bilan ma'lumot almasha oladi.

tasks.en: 2 (d) That's the same thing as the Web, isn't it? Not quite. The Internet links computers, and the World Wide Web is a system which links the information stored inside these computers.
tasks.uz: 2 (d) Bu Veb bilan bir xil narsami? Unchalik emas. Internet kompyuterlarni bog'laydi, Butunjahon o'rgimchak to'ri esa bu kompyuterlarda saqlanadigan ma'lumotni bog'lovchi tizim.

tasks.en: 3 (f) What is a web site, and how do I visit one? A company or organisation stores its information in electronic documents on one of the Internet computers, somewhere in the world. This computer space - the company's web site - has an address, in the same way that every telephone has a number. To visit a web site, you simply enter the address. Your computer is connected to the web site, a document is downloaded, and a page appears on your computer screen.
tasks.uz: 3 (f) Veb-sayt nima va unga qanday kiraman? Kompaniya yoki tashkilot ma'lumotini dunyoning biror yeridagi Internet kompyuterlaridan birida elektron hujjatlarda saqlaydi. Bu kompyuter maydoni - kompaniyaning veb-sayti - har telefonda raqam bo'lgani kabi manzilga ega. Saytga kirish uchun shunchaki manzilni kiritasiz. Kompyuteringiz saytga ulanadi, hujjat yuklab olinadi va ekraningizda sahifa paydo bo'ladi.

tasks.en: 4 (c) How do I "surf the net"? When you visit a web site looking for information, some words on the page may be underlined, showing that there is more information about the subject in another document. If you click on one of these words, the Web automatically connects your computer to a new document or web site, even if this is stored thousands of kilometres away. You're surfing the net!
tasks.uz: 4 (c) Internetda qanday 'kezaman'? Ma'lumot izlab saytga kirganingizda, sahifadagi ba'zi so'zlar tagiga chizilgan bo'lishi mumkin - bu mavzu haqida boshqa hujjatda ko'proq ma'lumot borligini ko'rsatadi. Agar shu so'zlardan biriga bossangiz, Veb avtomatik ravishda kompyuteringizni yangi hujjat yoki saytga ulaydi - hatto u minglab kilometr uzoqda saqlansa ham. Siz Internetda kezyapsiz!

tasks.en: 5 (e) What can I use the Internet for? The main use of the Internet is to find information - for your schoolwork or job, or just to find out more about your hobbies, sports or current events. You can also use the Internet to read newspapers and magazines, play games, plan your holiday or buy things from your favourite shop. E-mail makes it possible to send electronic messages anywhere in the world in seconds, and you can use the Internet to 'chat' with people and make new friends.
tasks.uz: 5 (e) Internetdan nima uchun foydalanishim mumkin? Internetning asosiy vazifasi - ma'lumot topish: maktab ishi yoki ish uchun, yoki shunchaki sevimli mashg'ulot, sport yoki joriy voqealar haqida ko'proq bilish uchun. Internetdan gazeta va jurnal o'qish, o'yin o'ynash, ta'til rejalashtirish yoki sevimli do'koningizdan narsa sotib olish uchun ham foydalanishingiz mumkin. E-mail dunyoning istalgan yeriga soniyalarda elektron xabar yuborishga imkon beradi, va Internetdan odamlar bilan 'suhbat' qurish va yangi do'stlar orttirish uchun foydalanishingiz mumkin.

tasks.en: 6 (b) What do I need in order to use the Internet? If you don't already use the Internet, all you need to get started is a computer, a modem and a phone line. Using the Internet is getting cheaper and easier all the time. Are you ready to surf the net? There's a whole exciting Internet world out there waiting for you!
tasks.uz: 6 (b) Internetdan foydalanish uchun nima kerak? Agar hali Internetdan foydalanmasangiz, boshlash uchun kerak bo'lgan narsa - kompyuter, modem va telefon liniyasi. Internetdan foydalanish tobora arzonlashib va osonlashib bormoqda. Internetda kezishga tayyormisiz? U yerda sizni butun hayajonli Internet dunyosi kutmoqda!
tasks.note: ⚠ 'cheaper and easier' = tobora arzon va oson.

exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

1) Internet reklamalari sizga
ma'lumot, ko'ngilochar tadbir, onlayn
xarid va e-mail xizmatlari dunyosini
va'da qiladi. Biroq, Internetning
haqiqiy dunyosi reklamalar
aytganchalik mukammal bo'lmasligi
mumkin.

2) Internetdan foydalanish ko'p
afzalliklar beradi. Masalan, barcha
eng so'nggi ma'lumot sizga uyingizda,
kun yoki tunning istalgan soatida
mavjud. Dunyoning har yeridan
ma'lumot izlab Internetda kezish
o'nlab mamlakatlardagi
kutubxonalarga sayohat qilishdan
ancha tez va oson. Shuningdek,
onlayn xarid kataloglarni ko'rib
chiqib, xohlagan narsangizni eng
yaxshi narxda topish imkonini beradi
- vaqt va pulni tejaydi. Yangiliklar
yoki chat guruhiga qo'shilib, sevimli
mashg'ulot va qiziqishlaringizni
bo'lishishingiz va ehtimol butun
dunyo bo'ylab do'stlar orttirishingiz
mumkin. Bundan tashqari, e-mail
mashhur, chunki u xat yuborishdan
tezroq va telefon suhbatidan
arzonroq.

3) Boshqa tomondan, Internetning bir
nechta kamchiliklari bor.
Birinchidan, shunchalik ko'p
ma'lumot bilan xohlagan narsangizni
topish soatlab vaqt olishi mumkin.
Surat, musiqa va videoli multimedia
veb-sahifalar jozibali, lekin ular

Internet do'stligiga kelsak, uyda

emas.

4) Xulosa qilib aytganda,
Internetning aniq yaxshi va yomon
tomonlari bor. Baxtimizga, tizim
doimo yaxshilanmoqda va hali mavjud
bo'lgan har qanday muammoni hal
qilish mumkin. Xohlaymizmi-yo'qmi,
Internet qolish uchun keldi, shuning

foydalanishimiz kerak.

tasks.en: The Pros and Cons of Using the Internet
tasks.uz: Internetdan foydalanishning afzallik va kamchiliklari

tasks.en: Advertisements for the Internet promise you a world of information, entertainment, on-line shopping and e-mail services. However, the real world of the Internet may not be as perfect as the advertisements suggest.
tasks.uz: Internet reklamalari sizga ma'lumot, ko'ngilochar tadbir, onlayn xarid va e-mail xizmatlari dunyosini va'da qiladi. Biroq, Internetning haqiqiy dunyosi reklamalar aytganchalik mukammal bo'lmasligi mumkin.

tasks.en: Using the Internet offers many advantages. For example, all of the latest information is available to you, in your home, at any hour of the day or night. It is much faster and easier to surf the net in search of information from all over the world than to travel to libraries in dozens of countries.
tasks.uz: Internetdan foydalanish ko'p afzalliklar beradi. Masalan, barcha eng so'nggi ma'lumot sizga uyingizda, kun yoki tunning istalgan soatida mavjud. Dunyoning har yeridan ma'lumot izlab Internetda kezish o'nlab mamlakatlardagi kutubxonalarga sayohat qilishdan ancha tez va oson.

tasks.en: Also, on-line shopping makes it possible to search through catalogues to find exactly what you want at the best price, saving both time and money. By joining a newsgroup or chat group, you can share your hobbies and special interests, and perhaps make friends all over the world. What is more, e-mail is popular because it is faster than sending a letter and cheaper than a telephone conversation.
tasks.uz: Shuningdek, onlayn xarid kataloglarni ko'rib chiqib, xohlagan narsangizni eng yaxshi narxda topish imkonini beradi - vaqt va pulni tejaydi. Yangiliklar yoki chat guruhiga qo'shilib, sevimli mashg'ulot va qiziqishlaringizni bo'lishishingiz va ehtimol butun dunyo bo'ylab do'stlar orttirishingiz mumkin. Bundan tashqari, e-mail mashhur, chunki u xat yuborishdan tezroq va telefon suhbatidan arzonroq.

tasks.en: On the other hand, the Internet has several disadvantages. Firstly, with so much information available, finding what you want can take you hours. Multimedia web pages with photographs, music and video are attractive, but they make downloading slow and boring. Finally, there is too much advertising instead of real information. As for Internet friendships, sitting at home in front of a computer making 'chat friends' is not the same as actually meeting people.
tasks.uz: Boshqa tomondan, Internetning bir nechta kamchiliklari bor. Birinchidan, shunchalik ko'p ma'lumot bilan xohlagan narsangizni topish soatlab vaqt olishi mumkin. Surat, musiqa va videoli multimedia veb-sahifalar jozibali, lekin ular yuklab olishni sekin va zerikarli qiladi. Nihoyat, haqiqiy ma'lumot o'rniga juda ko'p reklama bor. Internet do'stligiga kelsak, uyda kompyuter oldida o'tirib 'chat do'stlari' orttirish odamlarni haqiqatan uchratish bilan bir xil emas.

tasks.en: In conclusion, the Internet obviously has both good and bad points. Fortunately, the system is improving all the time, and any problems which still exist can be solved. Whether we like it or not, the Internet is here to stay, so we have to make the best possible use of it.
tasks.uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, Internetning aniq yaxshi va yomon tomonlari bor. Baxtimizga, tizim doimo yaxshilanmoqda va hali mavjud bo'lgan har qanday muammoni hal qilish mumkin. Xohlaymizmi-yo'qmi, Internet qolish uchun keldi, shuning uchun undan iloji boricha yaxshi foydalanishimiz kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Question tags are short questions at the end of statements. We use them in speech when we want to confirm something or when we want to find out if something is true or not. Dogs swim, don't they? Your father is a farmer, isn't he? Form: We form a question tag with the auxiliary or modal verb of the main sentence and the appropriate subject pronoun. Mary is cooking, isn't she? Tom can't play the violin, can he? When the verb of the main sentence is in the present simple, we form the question tag with the auxiliary verb do/does and the subject pronoun. When the verb is in the past simple, we form the question tag with the auxiliary did and the subject pronoun. Carol likes football, doesn't she? He found his book, didn't he? When the sentence is positive, the question tag is negative. He works for a large computer firm, doesn't he? When the sentence is negative, the question tag is positive. She didn't do her homework, did she?

Itlar suzadi, shundaymi? Dadangiz fermer, shundaymi? Shakli: ajratilgan savol asosiy gapning yordamchi yoki modal fe'li + mos olmosh bilan tuziladi. Meri ovqat pishiryapti, shundaymi? Tom skripka chala olmaydi, shundaymi? Asosiy gap fe'li present simple bo'lsa, savol do/does + olmosh bilan; past simple bo'lsa did + olmosh bilan tuziladi. Kerol futbolni yoqtiradi, shundaymi? U kitobini topdi, shundaymi? Gap tasdiq bo'lsa, savol inkor. U katta kompyuter firmasida ishlaydi, shundaymi? Gap inkor bo'lsa, savol tasdiq. U uy vazifasini qilmadi, shundaymi?

exercises.instructionEn: Some verbs/expressions form question tags differently. Study the following examples: a) I am → aren't I? I am quick, aren't I? b) Don't → will you? Don't talk, will you? c) Imperative → will/won't you? Stop shouting, will/won't you? d) Let's → shall we? Let's go out for dinner, shall we? e) I have (got) → haven't I? (= I possess) He has got a large house, hasn't he? f) I have → don't I? (other meanings) She has dinner at 6 o'clock, doesn't she? g) There is/are → isn't/aren't there? There is a cushion on the sofa, isn't there? h) This/That is → isn't it? That's Bob's bicycle, isn't it? Intonation: When we are sure of the answer and expect agreement, the voice goes down in the question tag. She's your daughter, isn't she? (↘) When we aren't sure of the answer and we want to check information, the voice goes up in the question tag. He can't drive a car, can he? (↗)

KO'ChIRMA BUYRUQLAR.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  QOLIP                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ask/tell + KIM + (not) + TO +
  FE'L

  'Check the manual.' →
  'He asked me TO CHECK the
   manual.'
  "Don't touch the wire." →
  'He told me NOT TO TOUCH the
   wire.'

  ⚠ INKOR: 'NOT TO' - 'to not'
  EMAS!
  ⚠ 'please' tushiriladi.

  tell = buyruq (qat'iy).

║  SAVOLDAN FARQI                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

    (zamon orqaga)
    'She asked me where I LIVED.'

  KO'ChIRMA BUYRUQ:
    ask/tell + KIM + TO + FE'L
    (infinitiv - zamon YO'Q!)
    'She told me TO GO home.'

  infinitiv ishlatiladi.

  = qo'llanma.


⚠ 'A WIRE':

  = sim.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the reported conversation, then complete the actual conversation using direct speech. Text: I asked Nancy where she lived, and she told me that she lived in Perth, Australia. I also asked her how old she was and she told me that she was thirteen years old. When I asked her if she had any hobbies, she told me that she had a lot of hobbies. She added that she enjoyed swimming, playing volleyball and that she also liked collecting stamps. I told her that I collected stamps too, and that I had over 100 stamps from many different countries. I asked her how many she had and she told me that she had about 220 from all over the world. I asked her if she had many friends and she told me that she did, but only two of them were her best friends. Their names are Amy and Ellen.

Sevimli mashg'ulotlari bormi deb so'raganimda, ko'p ekanini aytdi. U suzish, voleybol o'ynashni yoqtirishini va marka yig'ishni ham yaxshi ko'rishini qo'shimcha qildi. tasks.en: When we write a for-and-against essay we can divide it into four paragraphs.

tasks.en: In the first paragraph, we state the topic.

tasks.en: In the second paragraph we write the points for, explaining each point. In the third paragraph we write the points against, in the same way.

tasks.en: In the fourth paragraph, we sum up the topic and give our opinion.
tasks.uz: To'rtinchi xatboshida mavzuni umumlashtiramiz va fikrimizni beramiz.

tasks.en: We use present tenses in such pieces of writing. We can also use words such as: also, however, on the other hand, firstly, etc to list our points.

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Internetda kezish kutubxonalarga borishdan ancha tez.

sentencePatterns.formula: Whether we like it or not, + GAP.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Whether we like it or not, the Internet is here to stay.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xohlaymizmi-yo'qmi, Internet qolish uchun keldi.

sentencePatterns.formula: How + SIFAT!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How wonderful!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qanday ajoyib!

sentencePatterns.formula: What a(n) + (SIFAT) + OT!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What a nice present!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qanday yaxshi sovg'a!

sentencePatterns.formula: IJOBIY GAP, + INKOR QUYRUQ?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You've used the Internet before, haven't you?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oldin Internetdan foydalangansiz, shundaymi?

sentencePatterns.formula: INKOR GAP, + IJOBIY QUYRUQ?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My modem isn't working, is it?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Modemim ishlamayapti, shundaymi?

sentencePatterns.formula: Many people are in favour of + OT + -ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Many people are in favour of children using the Internet.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'p odamlar bolalarning Internetdan foydalanishi tarafdori.

sentencePatterns.formula: On the other hand, some people are against + -ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: On the other hand, some people are against letting children surf the net on their own.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Boshqa tomondan, ba'zi odamlar bolalarni o'zlari Internetda kezishga qo'yishga qarshi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X offers many advantages, but + GAP.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Internet offers many advantages, but children should be supervised.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Internet ko'p afzalliklar beradi, lekin bolalar nazorat qilinishi kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: You are ..., aren't you? - Yes, I am.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You are a student, aren't you? - Yes, I am.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Siz talabasiz, shundaymi? - Ha.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + told / asked / ordered + KIMGA + (not) + to + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He told me to be polite with the customers. He asked me not to talk so much.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U menga mijozlar bilan xushmuomala bo'lishni aytdi. U mendan ko'p gapirmaslikni so'radi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What + a/an + SIFAT + OT! / How + SIFAT + EGA + FE'L!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What a beautiful day! How pretty she is!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qanday go'zal kun! U qanday chiroyli!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ What - ot bilan, How - sifat bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: TASDIQ GAP, + INKOR YORDAMChI + OLMOSh? / INKOR GAP, + TASDIQ YORDAMChI + OLMOSh?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Carol likes football, doesn't she? She didn't do her homework, did she?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kerol futbolni yoqtiradi, shundaymi? U uy vazifasini qilmadi, shundaymi?

sentencePatterns.formula: Let's + FE'L, shall we? / BUYRUQ, will you?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Let's go out for dinner, shall we? Don't talk, will you?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kechki ovqatga chiqaylik, a? Gapirma, xo'pmi?

sentencePatterns.formula: She told + KIMGA + to + FE'L / not to + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She told Jerry to pass her a bowl. She told Susie not to forget to close the oven door.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Jerriga kosa uzatishni aytdi. U Syuziga duxovka eshigini yopishni unutmaslikni aytdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + asked + KIMDAN + (not) to + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mrs Cross asked her dogsitter not to give him any sweets.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Missis Kross it qarovchisidan unga shirinlik bermaslikni so'radi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What a/an + SIFAT + OT! / How + SIFAT!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What a lovely surprise! How awful!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qanday yoqimli syurpriz! Qanday dahshat!

sentencePatterns.formula: How + RAVISh/SIFAT + EGA + FE'L!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How gracefully they dance! How busy he is!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular qanday nafis raqs tushishadi! U qanday band!

sentencePatterns.formula: GAP, + TESKARI YORDAMChI + OLMOSh? - Yes/No, + OLMOSh + YORDAMChI.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Karen can sew, can't she? - Yes, she can. That isn't Rick, is it? - No, it isn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Karen tika oladi, shundaymi? - Ha, oladi. Bu Rik emas, shundaymi? - Yo'q, emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: Let's ..., shall we? / BUYRUQ, will you? / I am ..., aren't I?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Let's buy some ice cream, shall we? Stop crying, will you? I am right, aren't I?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Muzqaymoq olaylik, a? Yig'lashni bas qil, xo'pmi? Men haqman, shundaymi?

sentencePatterns.formula: GAP, + SAVOL? ↘ (ishonch) / ↗ (tekshirish)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Your mother is a chef, isn't she? ↘ It's going to rain, isn't it? ↗
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Onangiz oshpaz, shundaymi? ↘ Yomg'ir yog'adi, shundaymi? ↗

sentencePatterns.formula: You have + OVQAT, don't you?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You have dinner at 8 o'clock, don't you?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Siz soat 8 da kechki ovqat yeysiz, shundaymi?

sentencePatterns.formula: If I were you, I would + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I were you, I would study harder.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, ko'proq o'qirdim.

sentencePatterns.formula: Did you get my e-mail message? - Yeah, I got it just now.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Did you get my e-mail message? - Yeah, I got it just now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Elektron xatimni oldingmi? - Ha, hozirgina oldim.

sentencePatterns.formula: I've been + V-ing ... What about you?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've been catching up on current events on the net. What about you?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Internetda yangiliklarni bilib olyapman. Senchi?

sentencePatterns.formula: How + SIFAT!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How wonderful! How exciting! How terrible!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qanday ajoyib! Qanday qiziq! Qanday dahshat!

sentencePatterns.formula: What a(n) + (SIFAT) + OT!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What a pity! What a gorgeous gift!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qanday afsus! Qanday ajoyib sovg'a!

sentencePatterns.formula: TASDIQ GAP, + inkor tag? / INKOR GAP, + tasdiq tag?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Bob likes sending e-mail, doesn't he? She won't download them, will she?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bob e-mail yuborishni yoqtiradi, shundaymi? U ularni yuklab olmaydi, shundaymi?

sentencePatterns.formula: You've got ..., haven't you? / You got ..., didn't you?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You've got a lot of fans, haven't you?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Muxlislaringiz ko'p, shundaymi?

sentencePatterns.formula: I read a book. The book tells the story of a girl.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I read an excellent book last week. The book tells the story of a young girl.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'tgan hafta a'lo kitob o'qidim. Kitob yosh qiz hikoyasini aytadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: How + SIFAT + of you! / What a + SIFAT + OT!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How kind of you to invite us! What a naughty boy he is!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bizni taklif qilganingiz qanday mehribonlik! U qanday sho'x bola!

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + told + KIMGA + (not) to + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mr Penny told them not to talk during the test. He told them to write neatly.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mr Penny ularga test paytida gaplashmaslikni aytdi. U ularga ozoda yozishni aytdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I asked her if she had ... → Do you have ...?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I asked her if she had any hobbies. → Do you have any hobbies?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men undan sevimli mashg'ulotlari bormi deb so'radim. → Sevimli mashg'ulotlaring bormi?

sentencePatterns.formula: Firstly, ... What is more, ... On the other hand, ... All in all, ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Firstly, you can buy quality clothes for very low prices.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Birinchidan, sifatli kiyimlarni juda arzon narxda olish mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: What a(n) + OT! / How + SIFAT!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What an amazing CD player! How clever!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qanday ajoyib CD pleyer! Qanday aqlli!

sentencePatterns.formula: X has many advantages. Firstly, ... Also, ... Finally, ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Working from home has many advantages. Firstly, it allows employees to work in the relaxed atmosphere of their homes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uydan ishlashning ko'p afzalliklari bor. Birinchidan, u xodimlarga uyning erkin muhitida ishlash imkonini beradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: On the other hand, X has a few disadvantages. ... What is more, ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: On the other hand, teleworking has a few disadvantages.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Boshqa tomondan, teleworking'ning bir nechta kamchiligi bor.

sentencePatterns.formula: This means that ... / As a result, ... / This could lead to ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Computers don't make mistakes. This means that they can help surgeons.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kompyuterlar xato qilmaydi. Bu ular jarrohlarga yordam berishi mumkinligini bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: In conclusion, I believe that ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In conclusion, I believe that teleworking will change the way we work in the future.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xulosa qilib, teleworking kelajakda ishlash usulimizni o'zgartiradi deb ishonaman.
